title: Driver Risk Standard: Reserve Base of the Incentive Reserve on Released Payouts
content:
## Standard

When a payout hold on a **Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro** earnings account is lifted, an incentive reserve is kept back from the hold-release payout, computed on a reserve base. The reserve base follows how many bonus entries were posted to the account within the reserve lookback, which is 3 whole months back from the day the hold is lifted:

- with 3 or more such bonus entries, the reserve base is the amount of the most recently posted bonus entry alone;
- with at least one but fewer than 3, the reserve base is the total of the bonus entries posted within the reserve lookback less the bonus clawbacks posted within the same lookback;
- with none, the reserve base is nothing.

The reserve is worked out from the earnings statement as it stands when the hold is lifted. Whatever is kept back from a hold-release payout is taken off the available balance in one deduction, before the payout's single rounding, and stays in the available balance to be paid with the next scheduled weekly payout.

## Criteria table

| Bonus entries posted in the last 3 whole months | Reserve base |
|---|---|
| 0 | Nothing |
| 1 | That bonus entry less any bonus clawbacks posted in the same 3 months |
| 2 | The total of the 2 bonus entries less any bonus clawbacks posted in the same 3 months |
| 3 | The most recently posted bonus entry alone |
| 4 or more | The most recently posted bonus entry alone |

The count of 3 is the dividing line: 2 entries use the netted total, 3 entries use the latest entry alone.

## Hypothetical cases

- **Two entries.** Within the 3 months the statement shows bonus entries of 50.00 and 75.00 and a bonus clawback of 50.00. The reserve base is 50.00 plus 75.00, less the 50.00 clawback: 75.00.
- **Three entries.** Within the 3 months the statement shows bonus entries of 40.00, 60.00 and, most recently, 25.00. The reserve base is the latest entry alone: 25.00.
- **None.** No bonus entry within the 3 months: the reserve base is nothing, and so no incentive reserve is kept back.
